newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel drops text reference to mark in speech.
newsitem.headline: Waigel drops text reference to mark in speech.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said in a speech prepared for delivery to parliament that exchange rates were more now in line with economic fundamentals.
But when holding the speech in parliament, Waigel did not read out that part of the text.
The section that he did not read out but that remained in the text made available to reporters said:
"World trade is expanding strong. The exaggerated appreciation of the mark since the spring of 1995 has been corrected. Exchange rates are now more in line with economic fundamentals."
